history: Adaptive research after accuracy027 on same repeatedly used Bundesliga pair, no independent test
gate_supervision: Automatic external corruption condition, not possession or BallStatus labels; tracker_noise=1,clean/short/long=0
features: 27 team-invariant quality features: visibility, stored-vs-position-derived speed mismatch, acceleration, finite player velocities, visible counts and same-team duplicate proximity; raw and rolling12/50. No condition flags, identities, time or reference labels as inputs.
quality_training: Each opposite training match, both halves and four conditions, every5th frame;50 boosting iterations/7leaves/lr.08/minleaf80/l2=10,seed129,no earlystop
frozen: 019 H/A probabilities; original014/015 and noise018 dead experts unchanged
gate: Noise expert weight=.5+(cap-.5)*P(corruption); clean baseline remains50/50. Expert logits mixed before unchanged deadweight.75 and decoder12/3.
selection: Highest four-condition spellF1 with no total misses/merges/FP increase; prior fold loss<=.01; noise fold no decline; each deadF1 loss<=.005; clean pooled frame accuracy no decline. Report accuracy;95% is a target, not guaranteed.
source: Existing first-division Bundesliga Sportec/IDSSE CC BY4.0, no new data downloads
